sources.snippet: Compression is an umbrella term for techniques that reduce model size or computational requirements. Common compression techniques include: Quantization: Reducing the precision of numbers used to represent model weights (e.g., converting from FP16 to FP8). This reduces memory usage without changing the model's architecture.
